en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘One day when Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> proceeded to Abu Al-Abbas, and he was at Al-Hira having come out intending (to meet) Isa Bin Musa, so he<sup>asws</sup> met him between Al-Hira and Al-Kufa, and with him was Ibn Shubruma, the judge. So he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Where are you (going) to, O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I intended (meeting) you’. So he said, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Shortened your steps (Reduced your<sup>asws</sup> journey)’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So he went with him<sup>asws</sup>’. So Ibn Shubruma said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying, O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, regarding something which the Emir has asked about from me, so there did not happen to be anything with me with regards to it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what is it?’ He said, ‘He asked me about the first letter written in the earth’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Presented to Adam<sup>as</sup>, his<sup>as</sup> offspring to his<sup>as</sup> eyes, in the form of particles, a Prophet<sup>as</sup> (after) a Prophet<sup>as</sup>, a king (after) a king, a Believer (after) a Believer, and an Infidel (after) an Infidel.

So when He<sup>azwj</sup> Ended up at Dawood<sup>as</sup>, he (Adam<sup>as</sup>) said, ‘Who is this whom You<sup>azwj</sup> have Granted Prophet-hood, and Honoured him<sup>as</sup>, and Shortened his<sup>as</sup> age?’ So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto him<sup>as</sup>: “This is your<sup>as</sup> son<sup>as</sup> Dawood<sup>as</sup>. His<sup>as</sup> age is forty years, and I<sup>azwj</sup> had Ordained the terms, Divided the sustenances, and I<sup>azwj</sup> Obliterate whatever I<sup>azwj</sup> so Desire to, and Affirm, and with Me<sup>azwj</sup> is the Mother of the Book. So if you<sup>asws</sup> want to make something for him from your<sup>as</sup> age, I<sup>azwj</sup> shall Attach it to him<sup>as</sup>! He<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! I<sup>as</sup> have made it for him<sup>as</sup>, from my<sup>as</sup> age, sixty years, to complete one hundred (for him<sup>as</sup>)’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said to Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup>, and the Angel of Death: “Write upon him (Adam<sup>as</sup>) a letter, for he<sup>as</sup> would be forgetting”. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So they wrote a letter upon him<sup>as</sup>, and sealed it with their seals from the clay of Illiyeen’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So when death presented itself to Adam<sup>as</sup>, the Angel of Death came over to him<sup>as</sup>, so Adam<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Angel of Death! What have you come for?’ He said: ‘To capture your soul’. He<sup>as</sup> said: ‘But there still remain sixty years from my<sup>as</sup> age’. So he said: ‘You<sup>as</sup> had made it for your<sup>as</sup> son<sup>as</sup> Dawood<sup>as</sup>’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto him<sup>as</sup> and brought out for him<sup>as</sup> the letter’.
So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So for that reason, when the promissory note is brought out upon the debtor, the debtor is humbled’. Thus he captured his<sup>as</sup> soul’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Khalaf ibn Hammad from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has narrated the following:

“When abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, went to meet abu al- ‘Abbas who was in al-Hirah (a place in Iraq), one day he came out for ‘Isa ibn Musa. They came face to face between al-Hirah and al-Kufah when ibn Shubramah, the judge, was also with him and he asked, ‘Where do you want to go, O abu ‘Abd Allah ? 5 He (the Imam) said, ‘I wanted to meet you . 5 He then said, ‘Allah has shortened the distance of the journey for you because we are here . 5 He (the Imam) then went along with him.

Ibn Shubramah asked, ‘What do you say, O abu ‘Abd Allah, concerning something about which the Amir (the ruler) asked me but I had nothing about it ? 5 He (the Imam) asked, ‘What is it ? 5 He said, ‘He asked me about the first document that was written on earth . 5

He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, showed to Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, his offspring before his eyes in the form of particles, one Prophet after the other Prophet, king after king, believers after believers and unbelievers after unbelievers. When he reached Dawud ‘Alayhi al-Salam, he asked, “Who is this one whom You have granted Prophet-hood and honor but his life is very short ?

55 He (the Imam) said that Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sent him revelation that said, “This is your son Dawud and his life is for forty years, I have written the duration of lives, distributed sustenance and I can delete or write down whatever I want, as I want, because the mother of the book is with Me. If you want to donate something from your life to him, you can do so and I implement it.” He then said, “O Lord, I donate sixty years of my life to him so that he will live for one hundred years.”

Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, said to Jibril, Michael and the angel of death to write down a document about it because he will forget. He (the Imam) said that they wrote the document for it and sealed it with their wings which were from the Tinah (seed) of the ones high above .

5 He (the Imam) said, ‘When it was the time for the death of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, the angel of death came to him and Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, asked, “O angel of death, what brings you here?” The angel of death said, “I have come to take your soul.” He said, “I have another sixty years to live.” The angel said, “That much you donated to your son Dawud .” 5 He (the Imam) said that Jibril then came and showed him the document.
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘For that reason when a certificate is brought out to show the indebted he is humbled. Then he took away his soul. 5 ”
